2026-10-19.caption: This is big news for millions! If you've been holding off on upgrading to Windows 11 because of performance concerns on your 8GB RAM PC, good news is on the horizon. Microsoft is dedicating significant effort to make its latest OS run more efficiently on mainstream hardware. This means less lag, smoother multitasking, and a better overall user experience without needing a pricey upgrade. We'll break down what this means for you and your daily tech life.
